tooltip.qihai.flare_gun: Offhand ammo first: red decoy, yellow light, green airdrop
message.qihai.flare.no_landing: No safe airdrop landing site nearby
message.qihai.city.arrived: You awaken in an old hospital ward. Collect all ten karma marks and defeat 50 monsters, then find the bronze bell beneath the temple.
message.qihai.city.entry_failed: Unable to enter Yuji Fodu right now. Please try again later.
message.qihai.city.locked: The bell gives a dull ring. Defeat each of the ten monster kinds, carry all ten karma marks, and reach 50 total kills.
guide.qihai.chennu_spawn_egg.usage: Use on a block face to generate Wrath Strider. Use on a compatible spawner to change its entity type.
guide.qihai.chennu_spawn_egg.controls: Hold the egg and press %s on the target.
guide.qihai.chennu_spawn_egg.cooldown: No dedicated ability cooldown; vanilla spawn-egg placement and spawning rules apply.
guide.qihai.chennu_spawn_egg.cost: Successful use spends one egg in survival, but not in creative. The creature is not guaranteed to be friendly; leave safe space.
guide.qihai.chennu_spawn_egg.lore: It has no warmth, yet feels like restlessness clenched in the hand.

guide.qihai.emergency_light.summary: A dim, continuously lit emergency-light block.
guide.qihai.emergency_light.usage: Place it to provide light level 4 and mark a route. It has no battery, fuel or manual switch.
guide.qihai.emergency_light.cooldown: Continuous light, with no active ability cooldown.
guide.qihai.emergency_light.cost: Placement spends one block in survival. Its limited light does not guarantee spawn prevention or repel strange creatures.
guide.qihai.emergency_light.lore: It cannot light the whole corridor, but insists that the next step remain visible.
guide.qihai.flare_green.summary: Green flare ammunition that requests a nearby supply drop.
guide.qihai.flare_green.usage: Fire outdoors with a Flare Gun. It launches straight up and searches for a valid nearby landing site after the current %s-second delay; descent takes additional time.
guide.qihai.flare_green.controls: Put it in your offhand for priority loading, then press %s with the gun in your main hand. Check for open sky first.
guide.qihai.flare_green.cooldown: Shares the gun's %s-second firing cooldown. Search range and descent speed are server-configured.
guide.qihai.flare_green.cost: Firing spends one flare, subject to creative settings. No valid landing site, an unavailable shooter or an obstructed landing can prevent delivery; ammo is not refunded.
guide.qihai.flare_green.lore: The green trail is not an answer, only a request addressed to the heights.
guide.qihai.flare_gun.summary: A main-hand launcher for decoy, light and supply flares.
guide.qihai.flare_gun.usage: Offhand ammo takes priority, then the first flare stack in your inventory. Red lures enemies, yellow lights an area, green requests supplies. Green needs open sky; allowed dimensions follow server settings.
guide.qihai.flare_gun.controls: Hold the gun in your main hand and press %s. Select a color by changing offhand ammo.
guide.qihai.flare_gun.cooldown: Each successful shot has a %s-second cooldown, using current server settings.
guide.qihai.flare_gun.cost: A shot spends one flare but no gun durability. Creative ammo consumption is configurable. A fired green flare does not guarantee a valid landing site.
guide.qihai.flare_gun.lore: One brief report sends distress, warning and hope into the same sky.
guide.qihai.flare_red.summary: Red flare ammunition that creates a hostile-mob decoy.
guide.qihai.flare_red.usage: Fire with a Flare Gun. Impact or the flight delay creates a decoy with a %s-block lure radius and a maximum %s-second life. Bosses, Wrath Striders and Ten-Faced Buddhas ignore it.
guide.qihai.flare_red.controls: Put it in your offhand for priority loading, then press %s with the gun in your main hand. Ammo cannot be thrown directly.
guide.qihai.flare_red.cooldown: Shares the gun's %s-second firing cooldown; values follow server settings.
guide.qihai.flare_red.cost: A successful shot spends one flare, subject to creative settings. The decoy can be killed, needs valid terrain and cannot control every enemy.
guide.qihai.flare_red.lore: The red light knows no fear; it simply stands where its bearer is easiest to see.
guide.qihai.flare_yellow.summary: Yellow flare ammunition for temporary area lighting.
guide.qihai.flare_yellow.usage: Fire toward the area with a Flare Gun. Activation places temporary illumination within %s blocks for %s seconds, using current server settings.
guide.qihai.flare_yellow.controls: Put it in your offhand for priority loading, then press %s with the gun in your main hand. Ammo cannot be thrown directly.
guide.qihai.flare_yellow.cooldown: Shares the gun's %s-second firing cooldown. Temporary lights are cleaned up when illumination ends.
guide.qihai.flare_yellow.cost: A successful shot spends one flare, subject to creative settings. Light is not permanent and does not promise to repel or kill mobs; placement respects terrain and protection rules.
guide.qihai.flare_yellow.lore: It lends the darkness a little daylight, without promising that dawn will come.
guide.qihai.holy_light_source.summary: A special light block used by the city's exit scene.
guide.qihai.holy_light_source.usage: Ordinary placement is unlit and creates no portal. Only the city-center light region after the central bell sequence opens the way out. Its lit state emits light level 15.
guide.qihai.holy_light_source.controls: Press %s to place; there is no held activation or ordinary toggle.
guide.qihai.holy_light_source.cooldown: No item ability cooldown; exit opening follows the city's progression.
guide.qihai.holy_light_source.cost: Placement spends a block in survival, and the light cannot be mined normally. It is not a portable exit that can be freely recovered.
guide.qihai.holy_light_source.lore: The light offers no answer to everything, only a way home for those still searching.
guide.qihai.incense_burner.summary: A decorative incense burner from Rain-Silent Buddha City.
guide.qihai.incense_burner.usage: Place as scenery. It currently has no incense, ignition, offering, storage or buff interaction and cannot replace the central copper bell.
guide.qihai.incense_burner.cooldown: No active ability or dedicated cooldown.
guide.qihai.incense_burner.cost: Placement spends one block in survival. Standing nearby or using it does not heal, consume karma marks or open an exit.
guide.qihai.incense_burner.lore: No smoke rises; the last thread of incense seems to be searching far away for a way home.
guide.qihai.karma_mark_chennu.summary: Wrath Karma Mark: one of ten proofs needed for the city bell.
guide.qihai.karma_mark_chennu.usage: Earn it by killing the corresponding city mob; a lost mark can drop again. Ringing needs at least 50 personal kills, all ten recorded kinds and all ten marks in your inventory.
guide.qihai.karma_mark_chennu.controls: Carry it. Once eligible, press %s with your main hand on the central copper bell area. The mark has no direct-use ability.
guide.qihai.karma_mark_chennu.cooldown: No item ability cooldown; bell eligibility follows city progression.
guide.qihai.karma_mark_chennu.cost: Ringing checks marks but does not consume them. Losing one blocks eligibility; traded marks cannot replace your personal kill and collection records.
guide.qihai.karma_mark_chennu.lore: The grooves resemble cooled fire, still keeping the direction of its burning.

guide.qihai.mural.summary: One decorative tile of a Buddha City mural.
guide.qihai.mural.usage: Normal placement uses tile 0 of the default Delusion design and faces the placer. Complete murals use multiple scene tiles; ordinary use does not change the image.
guide.qihai.mural.cooldown: No active ability or dedicated cooldown.
guide.qihai.mural.cost: Placement spends one tile in survival. A single item does not create a complete mural or provide teleportation or combat effects.
guide.qihai.mural.lore: The story on the wall is divided into tiles; the cracks join them into another telling.
guide.qihai.neon_sign_pink.summary: A glowing sign with a default pink glyph.
guide.qihai.neon_sign_pink.usage: Placement emits light level 12 using the pink, first-glyph, north-facing default state. Ordinary use does not cycle its color or design.
guide.qihai.neon_sign_pink.controls: Press %s to place for decoration or lighting.
guide.qihai.neon_sign_pink.cooldown: Continuous light with no active cooldown or power supply.
guide.qihai.neon_sign_pink.cost: Placement spends one block in survival. The sign is not a safety barrier and does not clear nearby mobs.
guide.qihai.neon_sign_pink.lore: No shop remains open, but the sign still carefully lights its letters for the rain.

guide.qihai.supply_crate.summary: A 27-slot container used by landed supply drops.
guide.qihai.supply_crate.usage: Use a landed crate to open its inventory. Airdrop crates generate configured loot; placing a crate item alone does not create airdrop rewards.
guide.qihai.supply_crate.controls: Press %s to place a crate or open one already placed.
guide.qihai.supply_crate.cooldown: No opening cooldown. An emptied crate disappears after the current %s seconds; adding items resets that empty timer.
guide.qihai.supply_crate.cost: Placement spends a crate in survival. Breaking it spills its contents. Empty crates are not permanent storage and loot does not repeatedly refresh.
guide.qihai.supply_crate.lore: Its corners still hold the chill of the heights; its seal is already waiting to be broken.

guide.qihai.wall_corpse.summary: A decorative tile of the city's wall-bound remains.

guide.qihai.wall_corpse.cooldown: No active ability or dedicated cooldown.
guide.qihai.wall_corpse.cost: Placement spends one tile in survival. This is a block, not a summoning item, and grants no guardian or extra loot.
guide.qihai.wall_corpse.lore: Its outline rests inside the wall like a sentence that hardened before it was finished.
